self.text: Hey! I’m Zed, a mid‑20s Aussie who’s diving into history—think dusty archives, secretive archives, and the stories that make us who we are. When I’m not buried in research, I’ve got a green thumb for urban gardening, turning rooftop corners into tiny oases. I’m looking to meet someone who’s as curious about learning as I am. Language practice is a big part of that; I love swapping words, correcting each other, and laughing over mispronunciations. We’ll work through problems together, tackling everything from tricky equations to figuring out the best compost mix. If we’re short on time, we can still have those quick, meaningful exchanges that keep the connection alive. I’m all about in‑person chats—nothing beats a face‑to‑face brainstorm. My schedule is flexible: I’m free on Saturday mornings, Sunday mornings, or weekday evenings, so we can fit a coffee or a quick walk through the garden in between our studies. If you’re ready for a relaxed, intellectually playful partnership where we grow our minds and maybe our plants, let’s chat!
